worldcombat.skill.weatherball.summary: Gather the sky's current weather into a ball and throw it: thunderstorm is Electric, rain is Water, clear sun is Fire, sandstorm is Rock, snow is Ice, and no weather is a plain ball; a chargeable sky doubles the power.
worldcombat.skill.weatherball.use.1: Amplify power in a thunderstorm or clear sun
worldcombat.skill.weatherball.descriptio: Gather the current sky into a ball and throw it: a hit deals about %1$s special damage; the type follows the sky - thunder->Electric, rain->Water, sun->Fire, sandstorm->Rock, snow->Ice, and no weather->Normal.
After %1$s s of gathering it is thrown in a straight line within %2$s blocks, bursting on the first target it hits; a chargeable sky takes longer but doubles the power.
worldcombat.skill.weatherball.timing: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.weatherball.preference: On: the ball passes through up to 2 targets at x0.75 power each, good for a line of foes; Off: a single target at full power. Both directions trade coverage for damage.
Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to throw; when off it stays put.
worldcombat.skill.weatherball.descriptio: The ball flies at about %1$s blocks per tick with a hit radius of about %2$s blocks; with Pierce on it passes through up to 2 targets at x0.75 power each.
